dispositions.decision: A published project_key_digest (or surviving witness) naming another project is a CARRIER PROJECT BINDING MISMATCH, not migration corruption. Writer or maintenance open and act C publication: operational-failed / 4 / LEDGER.CORRUPT / ledger-corrupt, domainDetail omitted, nothing appended or published. Read-only recovery: an association whose journalCarrierDigest, storeGenerationDigest or namespaceId differs from the admitted binding is binding-unusable (existing S12 request-rejected / 2 / EXTENSION.ADMISSION_REJECTED, RECOVERY.REFUSED); with the association naming the admitted carrier, the carrier's own row or witness naming another project is unknown-quarantine-condition (LEDGER.CORRUPT, ledger-corrupt, omitted) under Step 4, otherwise unavailable-busy. MIGRATION.CORRUPT remains only for the migration footprint itself (partial object set, invalid definitions, v3 rows before publication, violated published boundary incl. F51) at a writer or maintenance open, and is used on no read-only path.
dispositions.grounding: frozen v8 witness law treats the same fact as a carrier quarantine; S12 keeps journal-carrier quarantine free of MIGRATION.CORRUPT; readonly section 3 already routes a foreign witness to unknown-quarantine-condition; S12:1306 already refuses a foreign requested binding.
evidence: p03 source37 binding scenarios and route checks

dispositions.F46: unknown-carrier-incompatible -> operational-failed / 4 / HOST.IO_FAILURE / host-io, domainDetail omitted; never not-committed, never a confirmation. Rationale: an association is written only with a committed carrierFormat 3 SEAL, so one naming a historical generation contradicts two retained owners (unknown-custody family); not a caller defect (request-rejected) and not a stably observed quarantine (LEDGER.CORRUPT). The comparison uses first_generation read in the same journal snapshot.
dispositions.F51: split-brain-custody-condition -> writer or maintenance open: MIGRATION.CORRUPT (operational-failed / 4 / LEDGER.CORRUPT / ledger-corrupt, detail MIGRATION.CORRUPT), which is the existing post-detection generation-boundary check; read-only recovery: unknown-quarantine-condition (LEDGER.CORRUPT / ledger-corrupt, omitted) with Step 4 stability, otherwise unavailable-busy. Detection writes nothing and is re-evaluated at every open; split-brain rows are never merged.
